title: Cranks But Will Not Start
summary: Engine cranks normally but will not fire, separating fuel, spark, compression, security, and engine-position signals.
intro: A crank/no-start should be split into what is missing during cranking: fuel pressure, injector pulse, spark, compression, or a valid crank/cam signal. Avoid replacing a fuel pump, starter, or sensor until the missing input is proven.
common_sounds: Starter cranks at normal speed but engine will not fire
Tachometer does not move while cranking
Engine briefly fires with added fuel then stalls
Fuel pump is silent or pressure drops quickly
Security light flashes during start attempt
quick_checks: Scan all modules for P0335, P0340, P0230, security, immobilizer, and low-voltage codes before clearing
Confirm cranking speed, battery voltage during crank, and RPM signal on the scan tool
Check fuel pressure, fuel volume, injector pulse, and pump command before quoting a pump
Check spark output and ignition power/ground during crank
Use compression or relative-compression testing if fuel and spark are present
common_causes: No crankshaft position signal or cam/crank correlation problem
No fuel pressure from pump, relay, fuse, wiring, or control issue
No injector pulse due to security, PCM power, sensor input, or wiring issue
Ignition power, coil control, or spark output failure
Low compression, jumped timing, flooded engine, or severe mechanical fault

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Signal and Command Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Prove the PCM sees engine speed and commands fuel and spark during cranking.
checks: Check injector pulse and coil command
Inspect CKP/CMP connectors and harness routing

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Fuel, Spark, and Compression Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Once command exists, find whether pressure, spark energy, or mechanical compression is missing.
checks: Perform relative compression if fuel and spark are present

recommended_repairs.title: Fuel Pump Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Use only after fuel pressure, command, and power/ground testing confirm the pump path.

recommended_repairs.title: Electrical Diagnostic
recommended_repairs.description: Use when crank/cam signal, relay command, injector pulse, or security data is missing.
